title: RESOLUTION (NAZARIAN - LEE) relative to designation locations in Council District 2 for enforcement against sitting, lying, sleeping, or storing, using,…
text:
[Council File 26-4118-S10; CD 2]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
RESOLUTION (NAZARIAN - LEE) relative to designation locations in Council District 2 for enforcement against sitting, lying, sleeping, or storing, using, maintaining, or placing personal property, or otherwise obstructing the public right-of-way, as further detailed in Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC) Section 41.18.
Recommendations for Council action:
1. RESOLVE, pursuant to Section 41.18 (c) of the LAMC, to designate the following locations for enforcement against sitting, lying, sleeping, or storing, using, maintaining, or placing personal property, or otherwise obstructing the public right-of-way, up to the maximum distance and effective for the maximum period of time prescribed, and as further detailed in the LAMC:
a. 7651 Laurel Canyon, North Hollywood, CA 91605 - Keswick Pocket Park - Public Park
b. 10145 Arminta Street, Sun Valley, CA 91352 - DeGarmo Park - Public Park
c. 5753 North Whitnall Highway, North Hollywood, CA 91601 - Whitnall Dog Park - Public Park
2. RESOLVE to direct and authorize the City Department(s) with jurisdiction over the identified locations to post appropriate notices of the above prohibitions at these locations to post appropriate notices of the above prohibitions at these locations, and to begin enforcement upon the expiration of any required posting period.
